cohort: 180 preterm neonates (<37 weeks gestation) who did not receive resuscitation or supplemental oxygen
finding: Oxygen saturations in the first 10 minutes of life in healthy preterm neonates are significantly higher than the targets proposed by the NRP-2020.
mod_finding: Larger preterm neonates and those born vaginally attained a preductal saturation of >90% sooner.
